author: GameSpot
description:
GameSpot was also able to attend a hands-off presentation, where we learned all about The Witcher 3 - Wild Hunt Songs of the Past’s Dandelion-centered storyline. 

CD Projekt Red returns to its fantasy-themed action-RPG after over a decade, and the developer says this expansion takes Geralt on one last ride “before passing the torch.”
